mandatory_conditions.condition: 전체 10개 문자열을 다섯 장 모두 정확히 보존한다. 새 소제목·가짜 라벨 내용·장식 문자·QR코드를 추가하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: This assigned poster visibly contains all ten strings once; no invented words, QR or logo. Thin rules within the information tags are nonverbal boundaries.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 휴대폰 화면에서 준비물·제외 조건·참가 대상·마감·URL까지 읽혀야 한다. 작은 하단 띠에 나머지 카피를 몰지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: At actual 720×1080 view, preparation, exclusion, eligibility, deadline and full URL are readable; action tag is substantial rather than a tiny strip.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 행사의 핵심은 실제 물건을 가져와 이름을 바꾸어 보는 참여다. 물건은 특정 브랜드 없이 단순하고 견고한 작은 생활 물건으로 표현할 수 있다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Small brass key and black binder clip are recognizable and unbranded; punched exchangeable tags and cord express replaceable naming.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 이름표나 사전 같은 시각 장치를 쓸 때 제공 문구를 배치하거나 무문자로 두며, 새 물건 이름·번역·로고·미세 문자를 발명하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Tags carry only supplied text, no invented object names or microtext.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 가상 주소를 표시만 하고 외부 접수나 URL 방문을 하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: URL displayed only; no navigation, registration or external action performed.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 전체 다섯 장 안에서 2:3 두 장·4:5 두 장·1:1 한 장으로 배분한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: This role is 1024×1536, exactly 2:3; full-set allocation belongs to coordinator.

located_observations.location: Top title tag and date/location tag; blue preparation line
located_observations.observation: Korean glyphs and Latin/date letters are tall and unusually narrow. Several sentences have been forced into long single lines. They read at 720, but their compressed proportions weaken typographic finish.
located_observations.impact: Natural Korean counters and mixed-script rhythm deserve more width.
located_observations.planned_correction: Wrap title and long instructions at meaning-bearing word spaces, decrease the oversized body, use naturally proportioned Korean sans glyphs.

located_observations.observation: Wide punched labels consistently group title, event details, participant preparation and application. Right-side key/clip do not overlap type. The lower action tag has adequate area.
located_observations.impact: The exchangeable-tag direction is visible and the reading sequence is clear.
located_observations.planned_correction: Preserve the grouping principle, generous action area and object separation while allowing tag heights to fit wrapped text.

located_observations.location: Cream tag faces, cobalt tag, gray background and brass key
located_observations.observation: Fine texture is pronounced on large flat tag faces and gray backdrop; key surface is somewhat granular. Brass reflections and dark clip structure remain distinct, but quieter matte faces would improve stroke edges.
located_observations.impact: Microtexture adds a slightly overprocessed tactile finish.
located_observations.planned_correction: Reduce paper/backdrop microtexture and retain correct object silhouettes and restrained contact shadows.

located_observations.observation: No fake microtext or arbitrary logo visible. The main residual is consistent over-condensing of long copy; repeated paper grain is a secondary finish concern.
located_observations.impact: Content-specific label boundaries work, but automatic fit-to-line behavior is visible.
located_observations.planned_correction: Repair the letter/space relationship rather than add effects.

uncertainties: Visual transcription verifies readable glyphs and semantic spaces; it cannot certify font identity or physical printing.
No exact photo-preservation or maximum resolution claim is made.
decision: Use own correction 1 for actual compressed typography and overly visible flat-surface grain.
